text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for pool dedicated-prod-7. p95=1.8s, p99=13.4s, queue depth=480, streaming stalls on /v1/generate-stream. Autoscaler did not add capacity in the last 120s (provisioning stuck). TriggerID: T-48213.

anna (oncall): Ack — I'm on it. Putting a short triage runbook in-line. @maya @kevin please confirm pool state and any warmup errors.

maya (eng-sre): Seeing a warmup handshake timeout loop in the hotshot workers. Lots of entries like: 
```
[2026-03-15T03:12:11Z] warmup: slot 12 handshake timeout (deadline 45000ms)
[2026-03-15T03:12:12Z] warmup: slot 13 handshake timeout
[2026-03-15T03:12:12Z] warmup: kv-cache coldpath miss surge -> backend thrash
```
Also an uptick in prefix cache miss rate ~12x normal.

kevin (dedicated-ops): Confirmed: all GPUs in dedicated-prod-7 are fully allocated. Two instances are in provisioning for ~90s and stuck at phase=warming. I see repeated handshake timeouts in the same timeframe. No recent infra deploys.

sam (eng-runtime): Likely combo: burst of long-context streaming requests -> KV cache coldpath storm + batch size stayed high -> some workers blocked for long tail. Suggest immediate short-term mitigations: 1) reduce default streaming chunk size, 2) route high-throughput customers off streaming path, 3) enable model-variant fallback for streaming route.

anna (oncall): Mitigation plan (short):
 - apply routing rule to divert non-critical traffic from /v1/generate-stream to fallback-model-compact
 - manual scale add 4 hotshot instances to break queue
 - temporarily reduce streaming chunk size and batch max to limit per-request GPU time
 - CS to notify impacted customers (ZenHealth flagged)
Let's run these in order.

kevin (dedicated-ops): Running manual scale now:
```
# adding 4 hotshot instances to pool
redwoodctl pools add-instances --pool dedicated-prod-7 --count 4 --type hotshot --reason "mitigation 1769456789"
```
ops-bot: Command accepted, provisioning started (job id j-88c3). Estimated warmup 60-90s.

ryan (oncall-night): Taking live mitigation lead while anna coordinates. I'll watch metrics and CS comms. @kevin ping me when instances report ready.

cs-lead: Customer impact: ZenHealth reported repeated streaming stalls and 504s for the past ~6m. They're in a business-critical flow. I've opened a customer bridge and the CS on-call is on it. We should prioritize reducing visible failures even if latency remains elevated.

sam (eng-runtime): Applying config patch to reduce streaming chunk size and batch cap. Patch:
```
PATCH /config/streaming
{ "chunk_size": 512, "max_batch_tokens": 1024 }
```
Applying now.

maya (eng-sre): Metrics update (90s after changes): queue depth dropped from 480 -> 210. p99 fell from 13.4s -> 5.2s. Streaming stall rate decreased ~60%. Warmup still showing occasional handshake timeouts but frequency lower. Looks like the chunk-size change helped.

kevin (dedicated-ops): New instances j-88c3 reported READY. Running a scripted warmup to prefill KV cache for heavy prefixes.
```
./scripts/warmup-prefill --pool dedicated-prod-7 --profile=hotshot-heavy-prefixes
warmup: prefill complete for 4 instances (avg 1.5s per key)
```

sam (eng-runtime): Also enabled model-variant fallback for /v1/generate-stream -> fallback-model-compact. This reduces per-request GPU memory and latency in the short term.

anna (oncall): Autoscaler config still concerning — seems it failed to trigger earlier due to handshake timeout gating in our handshake healthcheck. Proposing to temporarily relax the autoscaler gating window to allow faster adds. If agreement, patch below.

sam (eng-runtime): Agreed. Patch autoscaler: 
```
redwoodctl autoscaler patch --pool dedicated-prod-7 --set "handshake_health_window=15s,provision_timeout=120s" --reason "hotfix 1769456789"
```
Applying.

ops-bot: Autoscaler config patch accepted; reload scheduled.

maya (eng-sre): Post-patch metrics: p99 now ~3.1s, p95 ~1.4s, queue depth ~40. Streaming success rate for ZenHealth improved from 62% -> 95% within ~3m of changes. No new 5xx for last 2m.

cs-lead: ZenHealth bridge reports recovery, they saw retries succeed and their user-facing errors dropped to zero. They want a short RCA + ETA for permanent fix.

anna (oncall): Incident severity updated -> P2 (customer visible, mitigated). Postmortem owner: sam. Please capture root cause: KV cache coldpath surge + autoscaler gating + warmup handshake timeouts.

sam (eng-runtime): Noted. I'll create the incident doc and include workload replay + improved warmup prefill plan.

ryan (oncall-night): I'll stay on watch for another 30m and then hand back to day oncall. If anyone sees p99 > 5s re-page. :eyes:

anna (oncall): Thanks team — great triage. Final status: traffic routed fallback, manual capacity added, autoscaler gating relaxed, warmup prefill run. Monitoring for 30m. Closing paging unless regression. :thumbsup:
